hero.title: RULES
hero.description: To make the platform comfortable and productive for everyone, we ask you to follow a few simple but important rules.

r1.title: Respect Above All
r1.desc: We are building a safe environment for everyone. Be polite and respect the opinions of other participants, mentors, and organizers. Discrimination, bullying, or hate speech are not tolerated here.

r2.title: Fair Play
r2.desc: All tournaments and tasks must be completed independently or together with your team. Plagiarism, using someone else's work without permission, or cheating will result in disqualification.

r3.title: Teamwork & Support
r3.desc: UGalaxy x Star for Life is all about collaboration. Help each other, share knowledge, and work as one united mechanism. Together, you can achieve more!

r4.title: Internet Safety
r4.desc: Protect your personal data. Do not share passwords, addresses, or other confidential information in public chats. If you notice anything suspicious, contact the moderators immediately.

r5.title: Creativity Without Limits
r5.desc: Don’t be afraid to experiment! We value unconventional ideas, bold solutions, and a creative approach to challenges. The main rule — think outside the box!

cta.title: Agree with the rules? Then go for victory! 🚀
cta.desc: Choose your first tournament, build your dream team, and show what you’re capable of.
